messages:
rachel: FYI — QBR prep for Cloud & HW partners this Thu. Need updated scorecards + MDF asks by EOD Fri.
rachel: Agenda: 1) scorecards 2) tier proposals 3) MDF rebalancing 4) joint announcement calendar.
mike: can we bump the Marketplace milestone into Q3? partners asked.
tereza: +1 on shifting, but that will eat into MDF runway.
sam: what's the current MDF pool for Q3?
oliver: @accounting-bot can you pull current committed MDF for partnerships?
accounting-bot: @oliver automated report: Committed MDF = $240,000; Available (uncommitted) = $60,000. See dashboard: https://dash.redwood.example/partners/mdf
rachel: thanks — proposal: reallocate $30k from co-marketing to fund 3 hands-on workshop credits for HW partners.
mike: suggest we tie workshops to a tier-2 -> tier-1 upgrade path so it's measurable.
tereza: scorecard draft pasted below — please edit inline:
```
Partner | Tier | ARR Influence | Joint GTM | MDF requested
AcmeHW | 2 -> 1 | $220k | 2 co-events | $30k
CloudCo | 1 | $1.1M | Marketplace listing | $50k
IntegratorX | 3 | $80k | Sales enablement | $10k
```
rachel: finance will need a 2-line ROI justification for any MDF > $25k (expected pipeline + 12-mo conv rate).
oliver: I can generate the ROI template; will drop it here by EOD.
sam: I can add forecasted deal motions and expected influenced pipeline per partner.
mike: also flag any legal/case studies needed for a joint announcement — Marketplace launches usually require a partner quote + security attestation.
rachel: can someone own the announcement calendar? @sam?
sam: I’ll take the calendar + draft CloudCo announcement, will loop in marketing and legal.
tereza: I’ll own the scorecard edits and tier-change rationale.
oliver: I’ll queue the MDF approval request once the ROI lines are in.
accounting-bot: Note: MDF approvals > $25k require VP sign-off and a signed co-marketing agreement.
mike: noted.
rachel: OK — target: final packet by Fri 5pm PT so I can compile and send to execs. Quick check — can everyone hit that?
mike: :thumbsup:
tereza: :thumbsup:
sam: :thumbsup:
oliver: :thumbsup:
accounting-bot: logged action items: generate ROI template, confirm approvals workflow.
rachel: thanks all. I’ll run a 30m dry-run on Tue 10am PT — invite incoming.
rachel: attaching the working doc link: https://docs.redwood.example/partners/qbr/1747001234
